summary: Publication was blocked before every irreversible action because the executor lacks npm and GitHub API authentication. Read-only release preflight passed for the exact release commit, package/runtime version, absent remote tag, absent npm package version, and non-mutating tag-push permission. npm whoami returned 401; the PATH gh command is an npm package rather than a usable authenticated GitHub CLI, and gh release/auth checks could not authenticate. No detached release worktree was created, no package was installed or published, no tag or GitHub Release was created, and no official Harness or Crew state was modified.
